entries.english: 6 Noun Classes in Kossova (Kisii) Recorded by C. W. Hobley (1902, p. 86)
entries.translation: Class I um- → aw- (umuntu → awantu 'person → people', umkungu → awakungu 'woman → women'); Class II o- → mi- (okuwoko → mikowoko 'arm → arms') & u- → i- (umogwe → imegwe 'arrow → arrows', umuchi → imichi 'town → towns'); Class III unchanged (muriro 'fire'); Class IV iki-, ichi- → ivi- (ikisiri → ivisiri 'axe → axes', ichiara → iviara 'finger → fingers', ikirandi → ivirandi 'gourd → gourds'); Class V u- → ama- (uwusio → amasio 'face → faces'), li-, ili- → ma-, ama- (liliga → amaliga 'tear → tears', ligina → amagina 'stone/egg → stones/eggs', ilikori → amakori 'path → paths'), ki- → mi- (kisimba → misimba 'cat → cats'), e-, l- → ama- (erino/lino → amaino 'ivory/tooth → teeth'); Class VI e-, i- → chi-, achi-, si- (imbandi → chimbandi 'groundnut', enjoka → chinjoka 'snake', enzwi → sinzwi 'fish', engoko → achingoko 'fowl', imburi → achimburi 'goat')
entries.pronunciation: u-mun-tu a-wan-tu / i-ki-si-ri i-vi-si-ri / li-gi-na a-ma-gi-na / im-bu-ri a-chim-bu-ri
